subject.title: fix(realtime): add timeout to WebRTC offer requests

question: Should Control UI WebRTC offer exchange use a fixed 30-second hard deadline across supported providers and network conditions?
rationale: The implementation and failure cleanup are correct, but current code, docs, and history do not establish an existing latency contract from which the deadline value can be derived automatically.

options.title: Accept 30 seconds
options.body: Land the focused fix and treat 30 seconds as the supported maximum duration for completing the WebRTC offer exchange.

options.title: Recalibrate the deadline
options.body: Choose another constant based on supported provider and slow-network expectations, then repeat the stalled-body browser proof.

recommendation.title: Accept 30 seconds
recommendation.body: Land the focused fix and treat 30 seconds as the supported maximum duration for completing the WebRTC offer exchange.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history for the Control UI Talk transport and its recent behavior belongs to steipete.
